controls: jointMLP64 original frozen metrics for context
guards_against_each_of_dense_and_head128: Original4profiles per-profileF1 loss<=.02 and five-classargmax accuracy loss<=.01; full+tailF1 nondecrease;5profileFPR<=.05;tol1e-12. Preserve all reasons/mean gains. No relaxation after reading validation results.
diagnostic_leaders: For each objective rank only dual-guard-eligible rows by stated objective, then mean5F1, smaller tau, smaller alpha (prefers current128 endpoint in exactties). Report all10 including ineligible/negative. No deployable selection or promotion.
strict_improvements: Report mean5F1 and worst-P/R/BAcc gains versus original dense/current128. No single tradeoff is silently required to improve the other objective. All rows retain promoted=False; root decides whether a separately frozen new experiment is justified.
outputs: CPU/tmp report.json + all10 x6profile metric rows CSV; controls; every profile source-group/document/source_set/role-support counts and overlaps explained. Globaltau, alpha, P/R/F1/BAcc/FPR/5argmax accuracy and actual per-role recall included. Natural tool truth0 and recallN/A.
uncertainty: No test or generalization claim, no bootstrapCI on model/threshold-optimized reused validation; next evaluation requires new independently deduplicated sources and protocol freeze before test access.
limitations: This is reused development validation; head64/128 were trained and selected using related development data.
The two readouts share selectedheads/train data/scaler and are correlated; mixtures are not independent estimators.
The tail is a subset of long-full, and10 long validation sources overlap long-single; profile counts are not summed as independent sources.
This protocol is proposed after a prior independent confirmation indicated further work; that test is not read or used to rank alpha/tau.
Previously seen C4/natural tests cannot be reused as a new independent confirmation or to pick alpha/tau.
No prior frozen source, selection, threshold, model, current-model pointer or test artifact may be changed.
